# Harriet Ainslie

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c13 P25](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0025), [v5 c21 P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Harriet is dark and large of build, possessing black hair, bushy black eyebrows, and slaty, steel-blue eyes. She has a stern, dark-eyebrowed expression, a swarthy countenance, and great beauty, paired with a rich, agreeable, deep voice that carries a hint of a male quality.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P54](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0054), [v5 c13 P25](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0025), [v5 c22 P8](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0008), [v5 c22 P38](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0038), [v5 c26 P17](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0017)_

## Personality

Despite a somewhat off-putting or severe initial expression, Harriet possesses a cheerful disposition with a robust, bubbling laugh and a great sense of humor. She is sharp-talking, brutally candid, completely truthful, and shows neither ill will nor small-mindedness. Intellectually engaged with global affairs and politics, she is an avid reader who enjoys sharp debate and intelligent companionship. She is also intensely averse to isolation and can be deeply dominating toward her sister.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c13 P25](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0025), [v5 c14 P39](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0039), [v5 c21 P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008), [v5 c21 P10](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0010), [v5 c22 P3](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0003), [v5 c22 P30](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0030)_

- cheerful disposition  <sub>[v5 c13 P25](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0025), [v5 c21 P10](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0010)</sub>

- avid reader  <sub>[v5 c13 P25](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0025)</sub>
- strong grasp of politics and global affairs  <sub>[v5 c13 P25](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0025), [v5 c21 P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- ensure Clementine adheres to her vow never to marry  <sub>[v5 c21 P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012)</sub>

## History

Harriet grew up in an Episcopalian family, suffering the loss of her father at age thirteen and her brother five years later. In her youth, she engaged in a two-year romantic relationship with Lionel Fairlie until a foolish disagreement caused an abrupt breakup. Following her mother's death when her sister Clementine turned twenty-five, Harriet fell into prolonged despondency and weeping; during this period of severe grief, she and Clementine swore a solemn oath over a Bible never to marry. Harriet subsequently lived a retired home life with Clementine in their house on the hill, dominating her sister while providing close intellectual companionship to John Ashdown. When Mr. Ashdown prepared to propose to Clementine, Harriet strictly held her sister to their vow. Later, when Lionel Fairlie began courting her once more after two decades apart, Harriet eventually yielded and agreed to marry him.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c21 P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008), [v5 c21 P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 c21 P17](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0017), [v5 c21 P24](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0024), [v5 c26 P15](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0015), [v5 c26 P17](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0017), [v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)_

- resided with her mother and sister after her father and brother died  <sub>[v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015)</sub>
- courted Lionel Fairlie for two years before an abrupt breakup  <sub>[v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015)</sub>

## Quotes

> He intends to propose to her, St. Laurence—I am completely certain of it. Therefore he ought to be given his opportunity to ask and discover that she is beyond his reach, Laurence.  <sub>[v5 c21 P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012)</sub>

> She would quite enjoy accepting him, Saint. I am aware of that—nevertheless she gave her word, and she must adhere to her word.  <sub>[v5 c21 P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012)</sub>

> I was capable of creating a superior world on my own.  <sub>[v5 c22 P3](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0003)</sub>

> Did it ever cross your mind how isolated I would be in this place should you abandon me? That would be unbearable for me—my mind would break. Existing by myself is impossible for me.  <sub>[v5 c22 P30](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0030)</sub>
